registry.title: Dataset registry
registry.lead: Registered datasets: current version, file, location, and each dataset's version history.

list.noneRegistered: No company data has been registered yet; only the default dataset is here.
list.registryOff: Company data registration is not enabled here; only the default dataset is available.
